title: Uwo murwayi
intro: Kera cane, mu misi ya mbere cane y’amateka y’abantu, ubugingo bubiri bwahagaze imbere y’Umuremyi wabwo bufise amashikanwa. Umwe yararemewe, uwundi ntiyaremewe. Ivyakurikiyeho vyari kubaye icago gikomeye ca mbere hagati y’abavukanyi - igikorwa kimwe co kwirinda kwihangana n’igikorwa kimwe co kwihora bibabaje. Woba ushobora guhishura uwo ndi we?
clues: Navutse mu misi ya mbere nyene y'ubuzima bw'umuntu kw'isi .
Nari umwana w'abantu babiri ba mbere bagendeye kw'isi
Narigeze gutanga ikimazi kivuye mu vyiza kuruta ibindi vyose vyo mu mukuku wanje kugira ngo nshimishe Umuremyi wanje .
Ishikanwa ryanje ryemewe rivuye hejuru, mu gihe ishikanwa rya muvukanyi wanje ryaranse .
Igihe natera ubwoba ko nzomwica, narahisemwo kudashira ukuboko ku muvukanyi wanje .
Nabaye umuntu wa mbere muri kahise k’abantu yishwe n’uwundi muntu ata co akora .

outcome.answer: Yabaye umuntu wa mbere yiciwe muri kahise k'abantu .

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
